title: ClawPatrol — Wire-Level Security Firewall for AI Agents: Parses Agent Traffic at Wire Level, Gates Each Action Against HCL Rules (Deno, 707 Stars, 40pts HN)
description: ClawPatrol from Deno (Ryan Dahl) sits between agents and production. Parses traffic at the wire level and gates each action against HCL rules. Three deployment modes: gateway (proxy), join (WireGuard tunnel), run (per-process tunnel via netns/NetworkExtension). Blocks destructive SQL, pauses kubectl delete until human approval. HN front page 40pts.
cross_ref_notes: Part of agent_security convergence pattern: ClawPatrol (blocks, wire-level, Deno), agent-pd (observes, Claude Code hooks), OrgKernel (crypto identity, 1369 stars), mcp-audit (signs MCP calls, 5 stars). 4 tools solving same trust problem from different angles.

title: Agent-PD — Police Department for Claude Code: 6 Deterministic Detectors at Zero Token Cost, Catch-and-Report Never Blocks, Covers Subagents Including Workflow Tool
description: Logging-only Claude Code hook records every tool and permission event from main agent AND subagents. pd CLI replays logs through 6 deterministic detectors: denied calls, out-of-scope credential access, permission bypass, self-permissioning, disallowed tools, off-task work. Tamper-evident hash-chained audit log. Zero token cost. Catch-and-report philosophy — never blocks. Sessions named by project directory + first prompt, not UUIDs. HN Show HN.
cross_ref_notes: Observe-only approach vs ClawPatrol block approach. Together with mcp-audit (signs) and OrgKernel (crypto identity), we now have 4 tools each solving agent trust from a different angle: block, observe, sign, or cryptographically identify.

title: OrgKernel — Enterprise Trust Layer for AI Agents: Ed25519 Cryptographic Identity, Scoped Execution Tokens with Tool Allowlists, SHA-256 Hash-Chained Audit (1,369 Stars)
description: OrgKernel provides 3 core cryptographic primitives for agent trust: (1) PKI with Ed25519 keypairs, Org CA signing, challenge-response verification. (2) Scoped execution tokens with tool allowlists, numeric parameter bounds, Ed25519 signatures preventing token grafting. (3) Three-layer hash-chained audit trail (IDENTITY/EXECUTION/COMPLIANCE) with SHA-256 integrity verification. Phase 1 complete. Future phases add mission lifecycle, policy engine, authority graph, tool gateway. Python + FastAPI + PostgreSQL.
cross_ref_notes: Joins agent_trust category (78 total). Similar to Caracal (id:1447, Ed25519 identity). Complements ClawPatrol (firewall) and agent-pd (observability) — identity is the layer below both. The cross-reference pattern: ClawPatrol blocks at wire level, agent-pd observes at hook level, OrgKernel identifies at crypto level, mcp-audit signs at MCP level.
